notes.title: JAG:FPS 0.0.0.3
notes.content:
[b]JAG:FPS 0.0.0.3 Patch notes[/b]

The objective for this patch is to fix critical errors in the previous patch and refine the system used by all the sights in the game.

[b]Patch Features:[/b]

[b]Jungle Map Fix[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/dca42782ef6231ae1164ed6eaca22b1ca981ca48.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Procedural Generation framework for this map now properly functioning. Game will now avoid having a hard freeze upon entering map.
[/list]

[b]Redesigned Sight System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/6937777ebfe4f0fae425dc95e079f34f71f6c110.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]The backend of the Sights system (and Post Process Materials) has been redesigned, this will allow for more flexibility and features.
[*]This change also allows for easy implementation of special types of Visions (e.g. Night Vision, Thermal, etc.)
[*]Some sights have redesigned across the board to allow for better visibility.
[/list]


[b]Redesigned Nods System[/b]
[list]
[*]How Nods have been redesigned to account for the newer version of the Sight System.
[/list]
[b]Dual Tube Night Vision[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/8f69e7fb99fe8e19aa6fe9ea7a14b20b01fafc87.gif[/img]
[b]Monocular Night Vision[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/7e0cc45604c27f188eb267ccddc2da04b8334ca8.gif[/img]
[b]QuadNods[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/62e9a3932f0069260a685df61b6b059d26b37d2d.gif[/img]
[b]Monocular Night Vision w/ Thermal Overlay[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/ca0af1b34900f7761fb4e9a43b05cb8a19dd7cf2.gif[/img]


[b]Special Scopes / Sight[/b]
[list]
[*]The changes to the Sight System allows for special scopes w/ minimal performance impact.
[/list]
[b]Scope w/ Night Vision for Long Range[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/fc74c5791b98e95ec001a4bf552647aa76c5437a.gif[/img]
[b]Thermal Scope w/ Red Hot Style Overlay[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/b3699a284168477d96c0b63c2f68b8307d212255.gif[/img]
[b]Thermal Scope w/ White Hot Style Overlay[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/f3159adb771bad0cde3f83793b6b86704d6b5399.gif[/img]
[b]Holographic Sight w/ Thermal Overlay[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923916/9c2f99d3d07bc097a3d1fd20923eaba844db37d9.gif[/img]


Thank you for all the support. Next patch will focus on overhauling the existing animation systems and every animation as I’m looking to utilize tools to improve them.

If you’re curious about the internal changes to the Sight System check out my video series that tackles the specialized method I created for Sight scopes [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLIWVEPf0D2cNJ1G6NzNYpGAW2agKir7l6]here[/url].

Check out my [url=http://neilgilbertg.ca]blog[/url] to see my general body of work.

notes.title: JAG:FPS 0.0.0.2 Patch notes
notes.content:
Main objective for this patch is to move the current Engine version from UE5.1 to 5.4. Along with the move this will utilize new features included in the newer version of UE5.

Patch Features:
[list]
[*][b]Migrated game from UE5.1 to UE5.4[/b] - Changed build settings that will allow smoother transition to newer Unreal version.
[*][b]New Map (Jungle Map)[/b] - With the power of PCG, play on a semi-dynamically generated map complete with new objectives and enemy.
[*][b]Changed how attachments are implemented[/b] - Before attachments are Static Meshes for attempting to optimize. Changed all of them to Skeletal Meshes, all attachments can now be fully animated.
[*][b]Properly animated attachments[/b] - Added multiple animations for attachments, from flipping a 3x Magnifier off or on to retracting/extending stocks. A new variety of animations added.
[*][b]Improved audio work[/b] - Audio now sounds appropriate for where it plays. No more hearing audio even if it's miles away.
[*]Further optimization work done to support moving to 5.4 and new method of map.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*][b]Change to freeze when playing new map[/b] - When PCG event starts there's, a change the game freezes and hardlocks. Unreal's PCG tools are fairly new, as such early adopters will suffer bugs that has never been found before. With that unfortunately, there are no fixes yet. 
Recommend to just keep restarting the game and loading the map until map loads without issue.
[/list]



Thank you for the few that showed enthusiasm and buying this [b]obviously[/b] shovelware of a game. This has been the best learning tool and testing ground for new ideas I have (check [url=http://neilgilbertg.ca]my blog[/url] to see the ideas I tested).
Updates will keep on coming as I look to test more ideas and improve my skills.
